detail.longDescription: I just installed a fresh miniforge3 with python 3.14 and created a spyder-env with spyder 6.1.8. I can open consoles in other python 3.14 environments, but not in a python 3.7 environment. The requested spyder-kernels=3.1 appears to require python 3.8. Which version of spyder and spyder-kernels do I need for that?
